newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CELTA LOOK SET TO SIGN KARPIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTA LOOK SET TO SIGN KARPIN.

text.p: Disgruntled Russian international midfielder Valeri Karpin is expected to sign for Celta Vigo within the next few days, said the Spanish club's president Horacio Gomez on Tuesday.
Gomez said the negotiations had been more complicated than expected.
Karpin had an unhappy year at Valencia since joining them from Real Sociedad at the start of last season.
He had been linked with Turkish club Besiktas where John Toshack, his former coach at Sociedad, is now in charge but the player said he has decided to stay in Spain.
